title: Titus Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Titus 1: the greeting, the elders left to be appointed in Crete, what the overseer must be, and the unruly talkers who deny God by their deeds.

questions.text: What does verse 2 say about the God who promised eternal life before time began?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 speaks of the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
Verse 5 says Paul left him in Crete so that he would set in order the things that were lacking.

questions.text: What was Titus to appoint in every city?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says he was to set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as he had been directed.

questions.text: What does verse 6 say about the marriage of the blameless man?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says he must be blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe and who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

answers.text: He must marry a woman from his own city
He must not be married at all
He must marry before he has children
He must be the husband of one wife

questions.text: How must the overseer be, as God's steward?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the overseer must be blameless, as God's steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent and not greedy for dishonest gain.

questions.text: What is the overseer to be given to, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he should be given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy and self-controlled.

questions.text: What did one of their own prophets say about Cretans?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 quotes a prophet of their own who said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons."

answers.text: That they are wise in their own eyes
That they are quick to hear the truth
That they are poor but generous people
That they are always liars and evil beasts

questions.text: What should they not pay attention to, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says they should not pay attention to Jewish fables and the commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

answers.text: The songs of the vain talkers
Jewish fables and commandments of men
The teaching of the appointed elders

questions.text: According to verse 15, what is pure to those who are defiled and unbelieving?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says that to the pure all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure, and that their mind and conscience are defiled.

questions.text: What do these people do to God by their deeds, though they profess that they know him?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says they profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient and unfit for any good work.
